summary: Enhance your NGO's impact with our Learning and Adaptive Management training course. Equip your team with essential skills for effective program implementation.
lede: Learning and Adaptive Management training helps NGO professionals convert data and experience into timely decisions that improve program delivery, reduce waste, and strengthen accountability. Participants learn to create learning agendas and key learning questions, establish feedback loops and review rhythms, and lead effective pause-and-reflect sessions. The course builds practical skills for adapting workplans and logframes responsibly while managing donor expectations through evidence-driven decisions. Participants also learn to document and explain adaptations clearly, keeping programs aligned with beneficiaries and donors as needs, risks, staffing, budgets, and reporting cycles change.
audienceIntro: This course is crafted for professionals working in NGOs and related sectors, ensuring a comprehensive understanding of adaptive management applicable across various roles.
modules: Foundations of Learning and Adaptive Management in NGOs
Building a Learning Agenda That Drives Decisions
Designing Feedback Loops and Evidence Pathways
LAM in Monitoring, Evaluation, and Reporting Systems
Managing Donor Expectations While Adapting Responsibly
Learning Culture and Team Behaviors That Sustain Adaptation
Risk, Uncertainty, and Scenario Thinking for NGOs
Knowledge Management and Learning Capture That Scales
Adaptive Leadership and Decision-Making Under Pressure
prerequisites: Participants should have basic knowledge of program management in NGOs, familiarity with monitoring and evaluation concepts, and experience working in social-impact initiatives.
